description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center located in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a unique opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for enhancing the lives of residents and fostering a positive work environment for staff. You will be responsible for strategic planning, financial oversight, and maintaining a culture of excellence. This is a critical leadership position that requires a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to continuous improvement.This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and making a significant impact in the community.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA or in a similar leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Strong leadership, financial management, and interpersonal communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
